A thriller / horror game where you play as a guardian in a top-secret offshore complex

CERES is pleased to welcome you as the new security agent of the complex. You will need to use the command terminal at your disposal to control the opening and closing of the complex's doors and ensure the safety of your colleagues.

Utmost seriousness is required. The slightest lapse in attention can be fatal, given the.. particular nature of our inmates. But don't worry, things usually go smoothly.

We're counting on you.
